decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk builds directly on the firm's office furniture know-how, and its own R&D lets it refine the product for growing flexible-workplace demand.
The chair family sits close to the core seating and upholstery competence, so the firm can interpret market feedback and extend the variants.
Floor cushions made from carpets draw on the firm's material expertise, but as a niche accessory they carry a moderate risk of being pruned from the range.
The designer sofa by EOOS is close to the core upholstery business and was promoted prominently, so it fits the firm's absorptive capacity well.
The high standing table is close to the established table and conference offer and is easy to integrate into workplace solutions.
The rug collection lies far from the core furniture knowledge, which limits learning from early results, but its curated-materials role and continued presentation suggest the firm keeps it for now.
